check.q: A tug starts to back an aircraft out through the hangar door. What do you do?
options: Stand still on the painted walkway and wait until the tug and aircraft are clear.
check.why: A tug driver pushing an aircraft backward cannot see everything behind the wings.

reteach: Find the four forces on the aircraft.
Walk the painted path with the mechanic.
Put the takeoff forces in order.
